head: BITCOIN VS GOLD:
*ONE NUMBER TODAY*
scenes.say: Bitcoin and gold are both waiting for one number today. It's called C P I.

head: CPI =
*WHAT LIFE COSTS*
scenes.say: C P I tracks what you pay for food, rent and fuel. Last time: up three point seven percent.

head: HOT INFLATION =
*HIGHER RATES*
scenes.sub: ~80% ODDS OF A DEC FED HIKE
scenes.say: Hot inflation pushes the Fed toward hikes. Markets see about eighty percent odds in December.

head: BTC FEELS RATES
~GOLD FEELS THE DOLLAR~
scenes.say: Higher rates usually squeeze risky assets like Bitcoin. Gold mostly watches the dollar.

head: HOT OR COOL?
*BTC VS GOLD*
scenes.note: SEND THIS TO A FRIEND WHO HOLDS BTC
scenes.say: So, one number for Bitcoin and gold. Hot or cool? Not financial advice, just data.
